de: In Nikolaev after the attack of drones lit up the territory of the cargo terminal of the company “New post”. The strike on the logistics facility was reported by the local authorities of Ukraine.

te: Canada plans to increase oil and diesel exports to the United States
de: The office of Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said the country intends to increase exports of oil and diesel fuel to the United States.

d: В 137 домах Владимирской области без света оставались почти 500 человек после атаки БПЛА, сообщил замгубернатора региона Александр Муромский в воскресенье.
te: After the attack of the UAV region of the Russian Federation without light remained about 500 people
de: In 137 houses of the Vladimir region were left without electricity almost 500 people after the attack of the UAV, said the Deputy Governor of the region Alexander Muromsky on Sunday.
